Tagalyst design notes Another conversation

Describe what Tagalyst is supposed to do, in detail.

Tagalyst is your Chrome-based system for organizing long ChatGPT conversations. It adds collapsible messages, tagging and bookmarks, full-text search, focus modes, text highlighting with annotations, an overview ruler that mirrors the whole thread, and Markdown export of selected messages.

How does the overview ruler work?

The overview ruler is a slim minimap on the left edge that mirrors the entire thread. Every message gets a horizontal tick with its number; stars, tags, and search hits line up in their own columns; and a viewport thumb tracks the visible scroll range. Click or drag anywhere on the ruler to scroll the real thread.

What about keyboard shortcuts?

Keyboard shortcuts are driven by a YAML keymap with sensible defaults: jump between starred messages, collapse or expand all prompts, toggle focus mode, and more. You can review and customize the bindings from the options page.
